name: PHANTASM
source:
A side scroller shooting game about space war that moved from the Moon to the Mars. Main character is a pilot in charge of the most important missions. Between the stages there is conversation among the characters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款讲述太空战争、从月球战场转移到火星的横版射击游戏。主人公是一名负责最重要任务的飞行员。每个关卡之间都会出现角色对话。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
